rationale: The Court is most likely to affirm on the statutory-coverage ground (the VPPA’s linked definitions of “video tape service provider” and “consumer” require a transactional video-service relationship), with Article III standing treated as an alternative or reinforcing basis. Expect at least one separate writing pressing a clearer standing rule (Thomas/Gorsuch/Alito) and a Sotomayor-led dissent (possibly with Jackson) arguing technology-neutral coverage and disclosure-based standing under TransUnion.
